description:
The CLI supports flexible phase selection (generate, load, warmup, power, throughput,
maintenance) via `--phases`, but the interactive wizard hardcodes the default "power"
phase without prompting users.

Users should be able to:
1. Run data generation only (--phases generate)
2. Run load only (--phases load)
3. Select specific phases for their workflow
4. Understand what each phase does

This is a significant gap because phase selection is fundamental to benchmark workflows.
